indicators.label: Religion-table population
indicators.description: Printed national religion-table total for each wave.
indicators.method: Use the printed religion-table total: 59,355 (1991 tabulated), 76,886 (2001), 84,816 (2011 non-institutional).
indicators.quality_notes: The 1991 total is the tabulated population (the report also prints enumerated 62,929 and resident 60,847). The 2011 total is the non-institutional population; the total resident population is 85,567 (751 institutional persons). The 2001 Table 14 lines sum to 76,889 against the printed 76,886 (+3) and the 2011 Table 5.10 lines sum to 84,804 against the printed 84,816 (-12); both ship as documented discrepancies with the printed total as denominator.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share reporting a religious affiliation after excluding None and Not stated from the numerator.
indicators.method: 100 * (printed total - None - Not stated) / printed total for every wave.
indicators.quality_notes: Affiliation is the printed total minus None minus Not stated. Not stated remains in the denominator and outside both headline numerators. All three waves derive from printed counts and printed religion-table totals. The 2001 Table 14 lines sum to 76,889 against the printed 76,886 (+3) and the 2011 Table 5.10 lines sum to 84,804 against the printed 84,816 (-12); both ship as documented discrepancies with the printed total as denominator.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share in the source None category (None/no religion in 2011).
indicators.method: 100 * None / printed total for every wave.
indicators.quality_notes: Affiliation is the printed total minus None minus Not stated. Not stated remains in the denominator and outside both headline numerators. All three waves derive from printed counts and printed religion-table totals.
